feedback_and_control_causality: Build a closed-loop robotic ball-balancing system in Simulink and Simscape Multibody.
The final two arm joints must be driven by finite torque actuators.

Use measured ball motion, plate orientation, and actuated-joint state in feedback to keep the ball near the plate center without directly prescribing the ball trajectory or constraining it to the center.
